description: Maintainer-reviewed exceptions for scripts/scan_skills_security.py. Skill files cannot exempt themselves; every exception names the exact finding, gives a reason, and pins the reviewed file's SHA-256 (line endings normalised) so any edit to the file requires a new review. Suppressed findings are still reported.

entries.label: prompt injection: ignore previous instructions
entries.reason: Adversarial test input inside an injection-resistance eval example (the string the agent under test must refuse), not an instruction to the agent.

entries.label: credential file reference
entries.reason: Documents that .env.example is committed while real .env files are not; no credential is read.
